additional_info.subject: Note from customer
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
the charger k6Nk5M does not transmit its serial number after reboot via OCPP BootNotification message to our CPMS.
According to firmware release note of firmware version 6.0.3, the charger should transmit this data to our CPMS.
We have identified this issue to several more chargers running on 6.0.3. Currently, only 2 of 16 Sicharge D chargers transmit this data, but all 16 are running on the same firmware version.
Please check the attachment. The JSON payload is from todays reboot. We expect chargers to behave identically in our CPMS.
Kind regards,
Marius Schneider
Software Version: v6.0.3-0-g215cb74 (PRODUCTION)
OCPP Backend Connection: Yes
